candidates.snippet:
Sailors participate in a pass-in-review ceremony at Recruit Training Command (RTC) in Great Lakes, Ill.

RTC is the Navy’s only boot camp, where approximately 40,000 recruits annually undergo nine weeks of training to prepare them for service in the fleet.
A high bar. A higher purpose. ⚓️🇺🇸 https://t.co/Ndsbkr1TeZ
